source_review.source: Google Search — Creating helpful, reliable, people-first content
source_review.principle: Do not add content for Search traffic, arbitrary freshness, word count, or site-size targets; require direct user value and originality.
Publisher content should be unique and relevant and should not use doorway or cookie-cutter approaches.
